title: Design: A/R Detail opens on All locations as in the design picture
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column and the Location chip show, as in the design picture, and the location switcher names both.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the first bucket expanded.
  • Open the design picture "Opens on All locations" (ar-ap-p4-opens-on-all-locations.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Compare the filter row with the picture.
  2. Compare the column headings with the picture.
  3. Read the Location cells.
  4. Compare the Totals row with the picture.
  5. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "As of: " (blue pill), "Customer: All customers" (resting), "Past due: Any" (resting), and "Location: All locations" in a blue pill with the pin icon.

Step 2:

  • A column labelled "Location" right after "Date".

Step 3:

  • Each row's Location reads its location's name, exactly as the location switcher names it.

Step 4:

  • The bold Totals row at the bottom.

Step 5:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.
  • The layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S5-R1: “Each report's filter row is the native report filter row of the newer reports (Inventory Value, Sales By Customer), in this order on all six reports: the date chip ("As of: 10/15/2026"), the customer chip on the A/R reports or the vendor chip on the A/P reports, the Past due chip, then the Location chip.”
  • S5-R5: “The filter opens with every location in the list ticked (All locations), so an untouched report shows exactly today's organization-wide rows and totals. "Select all" ticks every location again.”
  • S6-R1: “All six reports have a column labelled exactly "Location". This renames A/R Detail's and A/R Collection's "Location full name" and A/P Detail's and A/P Unpaid Invoices' "Location Name", and adds the column to A/R Summary and A/P Summary.”
  • S6-R2: “The column is shown when two or more locations are ticked (All locations counts when the report's list has two or more) and hidden when one or none is ticked.”
  • S6-R3: “It sits right after the Date column, before the money columns; on A/R Summary and A/P Summary, which have no Date column, right after the customer or vendor name.”
  • S5-R4: “Each location is named exactly as the location switcher in the top right of ShopView names it, and the Location column uses the same name.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-opens-on-all-locations.png: figure "Opens on All locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p4-every-location-no-way-to-narrow.png: figure "Every location, no way to narrow" (Production (before)), board "4. Location filter and Location column" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "Native filter row: As of, Customer, Past due, then Location, which opens on "Location: All locations". Untouched, the report matches today. Column labelled "Location", after Date. S5-R1, S5-R2, S5-R5, S6-R1 to S6-R3." (caption of "Opens on All locations")
  • "The reports show the whole organization. The column is "Location Full Name" here and "Location Name" on A/P; the Summaries have none." (caption of "Every location, no way to narrow")
